placements.overview:
HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University is a public university, established in 2010 in Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh. HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University is approved by CoA and AICTE and offers a total of 35 courses at UG, PG and Doctorate levels in 13 specialisations such as Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Automobile Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science Engineering and Electrical Engineering. Furthermore, it offer courses such as B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, B.Sc. and M.Sc. in Full Time mode. HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University fee structure includes a total tuition fee ranging from INR 4,000 to 4,63,200. HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University has an annual seat intake of 367 for all the programmes. It offers courses, in streams such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Architecture & Planning and Hospitality & Travel. The institute has a safe and well-equipped campus with all the advanced facilities.

Himachal Pradesh Technical University offers UG, PG, and diploma courses in the streams of Engineering and Hospitality & Travel, among others. The popular programmes at HPTU include M.Sc., MCA, and MBA/ PGDM.

Himachal Pradesh Technical University offers admissions to various UG, PG, and diploma courses in the streams of Engineering, Management, Hospitality, Science, Humanities, and others. Himachal Pradesh Technical University course admissions are based on the merit obtained in the qualifying exam, along with valid entrance scores for specific courses.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University offers a wide range of programmes to students at the UG and PG levels. The college is mainly concerned with streams such as Engineering, Medicine & Health Sciences and Business & Management Studies. At the UG level, the college offers courses such as B.E. / B.Tech, B.Sc. and B.Arch. At the PG level, the college offers courses such as M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM and M.Sc. HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University courses are offered to students in Full Time mode. Further, the fees structure for HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University courses stands around INR 4,000 to 4,63,200.

admission_overview.title: Himachal Pradesh Technical University Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: HPTU - Himachal Pradesh Technical University admissions are both merit and entrance-based. At the UG level, Himachal Pradesh Technical University offers BTech, BPharm, BSc, BBA, BCA and BArch programmes. Candidates seeking admission to any of these programmes are evaluated based on academic merit and course-specific entrance exam scores. The duration of these courses varies from course to course. Some of the UG programmes are also offered in lateral entry mode. The first 50 per cent of seats are filled through the students' scores in JEE Main, and the remaining 50 per cent of seats are selected based on the merit of HPCET. At the postgraduate level, the University offers several courses under its various faculties, such as Engineering, Management, Science, etc. Admission to all the courses offered under any faculty is entrance-based.

paragraphs: Aman Bhalla Group of Institutes admission 2025is a blend of entrance and merit-based. Entrance exam scores may be taken into consideration for certain courses/ cases. Students can pursue a variety of programmes in the fields of Engineering, Technology, Nursing, Agriculture, and more. These programmes are offered at undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. Also known asABGI, the institute provides its programmes via its colleges, such as the College of Pharmacy, College of Nursing, College of Engineering, etc. The admission process of the institution is carried out in offline mode generally. Interested students can read the following article to know all about the admission process, courses, eligibility, selection criteria, and other information for Aman Bhalla Group of Institutes.

Aman Bhalla Group of Institutes, Pathankot admission criteriais a blend of merit and entrance depending on the course selected by the candidates. Students seeking to get into any of the offered courses are required to satisfy the eligibility requirements as specified by the concerned authority. The selection criteria may vary depending on the specialisation. The courses are offered in full-time mode. Aspirants can take a look at the following table to know about the general eligibility and selection criteria for some of the popularABGI Pathankot courses:

The admission procedure for Aman Bhalla Group of Institutes includes several steps from registration, selection, and counselling (if applicable), and ends with admission confirmation. Aspirants need to ensure that they satisfy the criteria set by the college before applying online. Interested students can follow the steps listed below to complete theABGI admission process:
Step 1: Application Process

Interested students can visit the official website of the institute to fill out the Admission Enquiry Form. Someone from the institute will reach out to the prospective candidate to help carry out the remaining process.
Step 2: Selection Process

The selection procedure may vary depending on the programme and specialisations. Students are shortlisted based on merit in the last qualifying exam. However, the institute may accept scores obtained in the relevant entrance exams. Additionally, students may have to participate in counselling for seat allotment.
Step 3: Admission Confirmation
For final admission, selected students need to pay theABGI admission fees.

Imperial College of Engineering admissions are granted based on scores of various national-level entrance exams such asJEE Main, GATE, MAT, CAT, etc., for respective candidates. The final seat allotment for all the courses at theImperial College of Engineering and Researchis done throughDTE Counsellingprocess. Imperial College of Engineering admissions are completely entrance-based. Candidates must go through a multi-level process to secure a seat at ICOER. Find below the detailed steps for the Imperial College of Engineering admission process:
Step 1: ICOER Application Process
Candidates willing to be admitted to any of the UG or PG courses must apply on the official website of the institute for their desired programme. The application form is filled in an online mode.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

As per the selection process of the Imperial College of Engineering and Research, candidates are shortlisted based on their merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, candidates are selected based on scores of various state/ national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main, GATE, MHT CET, CAT, etc. Candidates need to qualify for the respective entrance exam in order to secure a seat at the institute.
Step 3: Counselling Process

After the commencement of all the selection rounds, candidates must register for the DTE counselling process. The final seat/ college allotment for all the UG and PG courses at ICOER is done through DTE counselling.
Step 4: Final Admission

Once the DTE Counselling process is completed, the college releases final merit lists of the selected candidates. Those whose names appeared in the merit list must report to the allotted institute with all original documents and prescribed fees within the scheduled dates.

College buses are available for almost all routes in Chennai, so there will be no issues in travel. Faculty members are quite good and have experience of more than 10 years. Most o...

reviews.review_heading: Thinking the Civil Engineering Curriculum.
reviews.review_text: Imperial College of Engineering and Research boasts superior facilities, including high-speed Wi-Fi for seamless connectivity, modern and well-equipped classrooms for effective learning, state-of-the-art computer labs with advanced software, and a comprehensive library with a vast collection of resources. These facilities provide students with an optimal learning environment.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure, and this year it has achieved autonomous institute status.
reviews.review_text: The campus boasts a better environment with large, green, and beautiful surroundings. Only girls' hostels are provided within the college premises, while boys have the option of private hostels or PGs. Numerous food stalls inside the campus cater to lunch needs after the break. Adequate security measures are in place on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Best time of Life was spent here.
reviews.review_text: College location is easily accessible, and the infrastructure and campus are cool. Free internet is available everywhere, but there is a mobile network issue on the campus. Classrooms are big and have facilities like fans, tables, and projectors. Hostel rooms and facilities are good, but its food is not good. We have a nearby canteen, but it has only good tea, not food.

reviews.review_heading: An average college for mechanical.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good; I loved the campus greenery and the fresh environment. We can study in the garden during exam times. Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus, including the canteen and library. Hostel rooms are small, but I really enjoyed that time; no ragging happens, making it a very safe place. The mess food quality is good, and they provide fruits along with meals. The playground for sports is in the backyard of the college.

reviews.review_heading: Reality and my experience.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is fresh and green, and buildings have facilities like lifts and physical disability services. Free Wi-Fi is available in college; the hostel is only for girls, not for us but in the area, many rooms and mess facilities are available, and the canteen food is fresh and good.

reviews.review_heading: Good college but need to improve some things.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was excellent, with plenty of greenery on campus and comfortable classrooms. Hostel is only for girls; there is no hostel for boys. We have to stay in rented rooms; the canteen food is good; on-campus sports fields are present; if anyone is injured, medical facilities like first aid are present.

reviews.review_heading: The faculty is not good; they cannot teach students.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, and this year renovations are going on just because the college has become the university, as there was no need to do so. The route to reach the college is very poor; no good roads are built, so we need to walk.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is very good. Only girls' hostels are available in our college. There are no boys' hostels. Our college canteen food is good. Our college pays more attention to girls' safety. They provide free Wi-Fi and a library. Labs and classroom are good. This college has a large playground.

reviews.review_heading: My engineering college is the best college in Pune .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is nice and there is greenery in this college. There is only girls hostel in the campus and no boys hostel is there. So there is a requirement of boys hostel in the college campus. There are many private hostels . I stay in a private hostel.

reviews.review_heading: College review on, Jspm's Imperial college of engineering and research, wagholi, Pune.
reviews.review_text: The college has a very big campus, in which a large cricket ground, a very famous place called civil chowk, are present. The college has various labs for various departments, like civil transportation labs, structural labs, irrigation labs etc. The college has good Wi-Fi connectivity.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are not good in our college but provides good education.
reviews.review_text: Hostel was not available for boys so they have to stay in PGs or in flats. There were two girls' hostels on campus. The infrastructure of our college was very good. It had a huge library, neat and clean classrooms, and a good campus.

faqs.answer:
A:    Kingston Engineering College has below criteria for taking admissions to it's various courses: CoursesEligibilityB.E. / B.TechCandidate must have passed VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. from schools situated in Tamil Nadu.
Tamil Nadu native candidate who have passed any of the VIII, IX, X, XI & XII Std. or their equivalent exam from schools situated outside Tamil Nadu can also apply. They should produce Original Nativity Certificate.
Children of Central Government Employees, irrespective of their nativity, provided their parents or guardians (only if both parents are not alive) have been serving in Tamil Nadu continuously for the past five years can be eligible to apply.
Sons & daughters of All India service Tamil Nadu cadre officers are eligible to apply. A Self declaration from the parent in this regard is to be produced.
Children of employees in the Public Sector or Government recognised institutions had been working in their organisations for the past five years are also eligible, irrespective of their domicile.
Other State candidates who have studied VIII, IX, X, XI and XII Std. in Tamil Nadu are eligible to apply.MBA/PGDMCandidate who have completed 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE are also eligible.
AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field.M.E./M.TechCandidate who have completed 10+2+AMIE or 10+3 years Diploma + AMIE are also eligible.
AMIE candidate must have 2 years regular full time experience in the relevant field.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MBA at TIPS Global Institute powered by Sunstone?
faqs.answer: To take admission in the MBA programme offered by TIPS Global Institute powered by Sunstone, candidates need to have passed graduation with a minimum of 50% aggregate. Admission is through Sunstone screening in the form of an entrance test and a personal interview. Reserved category students can be provided relaxation in percentage as per institute norms. Merit and performance in screening will be the basis for selection.

faqs.question: Does TIPS Global Institute powered by Sunstone offer placement support for MBA students?
faqs.answer: Yes, TIPS Global Institute powered by Sunstone offers placement assistance to MBA students under its Placement Accountability Programme. The institute partners with best recruiters and conducts training, mock interviews, and industry workshops. The programme enables students to develop the skills to get job placements. Several institute graduates have been placed in good companies.

faqs.question: Is there any entrance exam for TIPS Global Institute powered by Sunstone admission?

Shortlisted students will have to appear for the Sunstone aptitude test that examines aptitude and subject knowledge. In addition to the test, shortlisted students will have to face a personal interview round. Admission is offered on the basis of overall performance in these rounds of selection.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to TIPS Global Institute powered by Sunstone?

placement_data.title: Rathinam School of Business at TIPS Global Powered by Sunstone Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The University provides more than 20 advanced certifications to expand the horizons. Alongside this, the students of MBA , BBA , and BCA courses undergo immersive internship projects in top companies for more than 8 months . Comparing the placement stats with other top-tier PVT colleges, the Rathinam School of Business at TIPS Global powered by Sunstone, witnessed the participation of seven times more recruiters.

During the 2025 placements, the University hosted a panel of over 1,200 recruiters. More than 150 job profiles were offered. The highest package offered during Rathinam School of Business at TIPS Global powered by Sunstone placements 2025 was INR 26 LPA , and the average package stood at INR 4.60 LPA . The ROI recorded was 63% higher.

Sunstone’s Placement Opportunity Program (POP) offers students access to 200+ assured placement opportunities, or a refund of their first-year tuition fee if placements don’t meet the commitment. To be eligible for POP, students must maintain a minimum average attendance of 70% across all credit and non-credit classes in every semester. They are also required to clear all examinations with a minimum score of 80% or equivalent CGPA, and must not have any backlogs. In addition, students must ensure that all fee payments are made as per the timeline outlined in the offer letter. Lastly, students must strictly adhere to the Sunstone Placement Policy Guidelines throughout the program.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com. in Computer Application - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: The American College of Madurai passed out student feedback and reviews.

review_content.Placements: A 12th grade pass with a high percentage (at least 70%) is required to be placed in a course. HCL, ZOHO, and other IT companies and banks are recruiting. Accounting and HR roles are offered for your course. The highest package offered is up to INR 350000 per annum, and the lowest package is INR 120000 per annum. Up to 75% of students are eligible for internship placements in IT companies and the banking sector.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure was really good and clean. The college infrastructure is fully green. On campus, there is a free 5G-speed wi-fi connection. Lab facilities are also maintained properly, and advanced labs are available. Classrooms are also good and clean. Every classroom has a smart board available. The library has a plethora of books that make it simple to prepare for group exams. Hostel facilities: good spread, bad spread, and clean toilets maintainedFoods refer to a four-day vegetarian menu and a three-day non-vegetarian menu. Sports and games are also available at your college, which is important for games and sports.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com. in Computer Application - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: I am satisfied with college but it would be better if they provide placements.

review_content.Placements: There are no placements. College offers a quality education system.
review_content.Infrastructure: College has a good atmosphere and environment. College prefers more sports activities, conduct games, and athletics. There is a canteen facility. One of the biggest libraries. Good infrastructure. There are labs for Chemistry, Physics, and separate computer labs for UG and PG.
review_content.Faculty: Teachers are very friendly and highly qualified. Their teaching quality is the best. Semester exams are moderate if you study well you can pass.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: The best and most joyful college in Madurai.

review_content.Placements: Many students get placed in my course. The college offers salaries from Rs.35,000 to Rs.40,000. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Accenture, and Google. Many students also get internships through our course. Some of these companies are NOVItech. The role offered is software developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our department offers state-of-the-art facilities to support both learning and research. Classrooms are equipped with smart boards, projectors, and high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity. Specialized laboratories provide hands-on experience with the latest equipment and software for relevant courses.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: "Comprehensive College Review Highlights Strengths and Areas for Improvement" .

review_content.Placements: Above average students got internship from the course and in our course you can learn about basics of c, c+, Java and python. The Bachelor of Computer Applications BCA is an undergraduate programme focused on computer Science and information technology. It covers topics such as programming, database management, networking, and software development. BCA equips students with practical skills and theoretical knowledge, preparing them for careers in IT, software engineering, and web development.
review_content.Infrastructure: The food in mess and canteen are so good and the infrastructure are also so good labs and classrooms are so clean. Canteens provide the best snacks. The computers in the lab are checked every month for better functioning. A colleges infrastructure plays a crucial role in enhancing the learning experience. Modern facilities include well-equipped classrooms, state-of-the-art laboratories, libraries with extensive resources, and technology-enabled space. Additional, well-maintained hostels, sports complexes, and recreational areas create a conducive environment for both academic and extracurricular development.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Com. in Computer Application - Batch of 2013
reviews_list.review_title: Lack of proper education. No permanent faculty present.

review_content.Placements: I don't remember any recruitment happened in our college. All students were worried about it. All students were regretting of getting into this college. But luckily all my batchmates are in good position now. Because of some strike in our college no companies came for recruitment.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure was okay. Our college area is spread over 44 acres. They are labs for all departments but 60% of them are closed. No sports, no cultural programmes.
review_content.Faculty: Faculty always kept on changing in our college. Only one or two faculty were good in teaching. All others were just dependent on the books. We expected good teaching faculty who can teach us practically apart from text book. Expected some special lectures from any outside. But nothing happened like that.

individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty which is not so helpful. College not recommended.

content.Placements: The placements and internships scenario at this college is bad. The highest package offered every year is only 3-4 LPA. There are some mass recruiting companies like Infosys and Capgemini, but hardly anyone gets placed because most students plan to go on to higher studies.
content.Infrastructure: The college has no Wi-Fi facility. The laboratories have inadequate equipment, with only five or six pieces for each practical, and students have to share them. The classrooms are air-conditioned, but the library is short of books. The canteen is very hygienic, but the food quality is only average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Inelligence (AI) And Data Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Average Placements/ Green Ambience/ Good Faculty.

content.Placements: The average placement is 4 LPA, and the students are placed on the basis of their skills. As it is the first year of B.Tech in this college, so we do not really know the proper amount. As the teachers say, the average placements will be 4 LPA, and approximately all the students will be placed.
content.Infrastructure: There is proper Wi-Fi in our department, classrooms have AC, labs are also there including a dark room, the library is also well-stocked with books. The food quality is average; it is not so good, not so bad. The menu differs with days. We also have a basketball court, a leisure hut, and gym wings.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I don't like the infrastructure at all, but the teaching is amazing.

content.Placements: I took admission to this college in September 2024, so I am not yet familiar with the placements. The faculty mentioned that they will try, so I hope we get good placements. As of now, I know that MBA course students get good placements, so let's just hope for the best.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not that good. Classrooms only have whiteboards, not even projectors. In the labs, the computers barely work. As for the library, it is mostly closed, and whenever we want to use it, we have to get a key to open it. I don't like that.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: I'm overall satisfied with the value for money, average placements, and green campus.

content.Placements: The lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. It depends upon your skills and confidence. According to this, placements are average. The college was initially made for management studies and this is its first year or B.Tech course that is why there is no information about companies that would reach the college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a well-developed Wi-Fi campus. It has a new library with new books and a canteen and hostel rooms with 1 seat, 2 seats, and 3 seats. The campus is very rainy with a large number of trees. It has peacocks too. There are rooms with air conditioners and a seminar hall where speeches are given daily. There is a girls' common room.

review_summary.college_name: Manipur Institute of Management Studies, Manipur University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, separate hostels for both girls and boys, 95% pass percentage.

content.Placements: Inside the college, there is a separate hostel for both girls and boys. If you are far from the college, you are sure to get the hostel. Mostly, around 60% of students were placed because of the comfortable reading and friendly environment. Internships are based on the marks you score during exams.
content.Infrastructure: Everything that is needed by a college is here, but there is some lack of sports and games. The campus is good with everything; you can get anything on the campus including food, books, pen, etc. Wi-Fi is available for every department. Canteen is good, and different types of food for breakfast or lunch are available. Hostel rooms are good. Every day, our helpers clean the hostel. We have infrastructure issues.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied, however, there is room for improvement.

content.Placements: During my tenure, I would say that the placements were quite good as compared to my senior batch. Around 10/15 companies including MNCs came for the campus recruitment which is rare. I would say that the people who passed out in the year 2015 are the luckiest. Tata Services and Nestle were the main attraction followed by Axis Bank, Vodafone, Image Consultant(Faridabad), Birla Sunlife(Insurance) etc to name a few. Local giants like Babina Diagnostic and Classic Hotel also helped us a lot. As for the salaries, I do not have any idea since the clear information was not shared with us. The biggest position offered would be General Manager for RadioCab(local enterprise), Assistant Sales Manager(TATA Service), Sales Manager(Axis Bank) as per my knowledge. As far as the internship is concerned, I do not have the exact information as right after I passed out, I did not keep in touch with my department as work caught up with my life.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied because the school has well trained teachers, infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: The placements for my batch did not happen till now, but my senior batch got a lot of placements from different companies. Till now, 43% students were placed from the college. The average salary offered is Rs 20,000 to 50,000. Most of the companies that came were from business field.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are all tidy and clean with good quality maintained. The libraries are not up to my expectations. Sports are conducted every Friday. The school has a volleyball ground, football ground and indoor stadiums. The quality of labs is fine. Canteen food quality is not to my expectations, the hostels room are a bit small but it is neat and tidy. I did not face any infrastructure related issue during my tenure at the college.

reviews.review_heading: I do recommend students for the best faculty and campus.
reviews.review_text: The Yenepoya hostel provides one of the best facilities in Mangalore. It provides the best food and accommodation, top-tier facilities in the hostel, and college facilities, and they provide college buses. They provide free accommodation and food for the sports students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by The Yenepoya Institute of Arts, Science, Commerce and Management, Yenepoya (Deemed to be University)
reviews.review_heading: Good for medical. Teaching is average. Facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms have very good facilities. This college mainly focuses on studies, not sports. The college is mainly famous for the medical field, but the medical facilities are not very good. Compared to other colleges, this college has good food and a good hostel.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by The Yenepoya Institute of Arts, Science, Commerce and Management, Yenepoya (Deemed to be University)

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by The Yenepoya Institute of Arts, Science, Commerce and Management, Yenepoya (Deemed to be University)
reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is an average college with good facilities.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is mostly useless and laggy in classrooms, and not all students get Wi-Fi coverage. Labs are good with plenty of keyboards and other devices. A good library is available with plenty of books. Hostel food is rated 5/10, medical facilities 6/10, and sports and games 5.5/10. All hostels and college buildings have good filtered drinking water facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Life on the Yenepoya campus.

Also providing many power sockets for charging laptops, and screens are provided to share notes and teaching. Wi-Fi is available in the college, but no access for students, and a library is available. In the hostel, the room is also good, providing AC and all. reviews.review_heading: Moderate academics but limited industry exposure for students.
reviews.review_text: The college offers good facilities like smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, and good teachers. Hostels are decent, with AC rooms, laundry services, and bus transportation. However, the hostel food is only average and needs improvement. Overall, the campus environment is comfortable. There is still room for improvement in both academics and facilities. Considering everything, I would rate the college 7 out of 10.

reviews.review_heading: It's overall okay. But not satisfied enough because of the fees. It's also increasing every year.

Hostels are good enough. In our first three years, we stayed in other hostel and internship time they will change our hostel mostly. Food and mess are nice in our hostel, and medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Its not that good, but its fine overall.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good. Labs, classroom libraries and facilities are all good here. Hostel is also good, the food provided here is good, and its very clean everywhere. Medical facilities are good here, we have a very big soccer ground and many turfs here, but the thing is that thats all. The main campus looks good, our allied college is not that good both are different.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure and facilities are really good, but the environment & campus life are not great.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are really good at my college. The quality of food and the infrastructure provided are pleasant. Some canteens provide tasty snacks during breaks. A good medical facilities, and a fascinating area for sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Yenepoya (Deemed to be university).
reviews.review_text: The facilities are really good. We do have AC classrooms with BenQ boards, which makes it easy for us to learn. The hostel is very neat and clean with good and healthy food. We have a ragging-free campus, which will encourage new bees to join our college and our course.

reviews.review_heading: The student intake at Yenepoya is quite overwhelming, and cultural differences limit connections.
reviews.review_text: I am quite satisfied with the hostel as it offers excellent infrastructure and comfortable accommodation for Allied Health Sciences students. The facilities are well-maintained, and the food served is tasty and hygienic. The food is prepared with good quality standards as well.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent MLT course and campus with strong practical training.
reviews.review_text: The MLT department offers well equipped labs for hematology, microbiology and biochemistry along with smart classrooms Wi-Fi, and a resourceful library that supports academic needs. The hostel provides clean rooms basic amenities and a safe environment for students. Mess food is hygienic and reasonably good and the canteen offers affordable snacks. Medical facilities are available through the campus health center and nearby hospital. Sports facilities including indoor and outdoor games help stud...

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worth coming over here, best faculties and infrastructure, but the classmates are a nope.
reviews.review_text: The quality and quantity are far better than any other colleges in Mangalore or in other hostels also. It is very nutritious. The facilities are also good. We are getting so much exposure at the Yenepoya Hospital yearly. There are so many tryouts for sports students who are interested in sports, and they have better facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good and well maintained. There are CCTV facilities, labs, a library, a digital library, a computer lab, and many more. The hostel facilities are well maintained, clean, and provide high service and security. The food is very good. The mess and canteen are well managed.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied.
reviews.review_text: Our college provides many facilities and has good infrastructure. There is a digital library, digital classrooms, Wi-Fi, and more. The hostel also has good-quality facilities. The mess and canteen are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Think placements, Think Ashoka.
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a rich library support learning. Hostels are clean with decent food in mess and canteen, good medical facilities, sports grounds, gym, recreation areas, and 24/7 security for students, good and well secured.

reviews.review_heading: Peaceful campus life with a good academic environment.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure. My college has Wi-Fi facilities, but sometimes the Wi-Fi network has some issues. Classrooms and labs are very clean. My college provides library facilities for students who come to the hostel for food. It is good, and a swimming pool is also available at the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Somewhat satisfied with my friends and friendly faculty members, but not with all faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Entering into the infrastructure of the course and hostel, we can definitely say that it is overall good. Facilities and infrastructure availability for the group department were good. They provided doubt sessions during college times, and after that, students could make a call to lecturers to verify their doubts. The food was good, and the hostel facilities were good. Compared to Hyderabad, this hostel was somewhat good.

reviews.review_heading: A place where you craft yourself better.
reviews.review_text: The facilities that are available are free Wi-Fi, Labs, smart boards in every class, a library, a cafeteria, swimming pool. The quality of the facilities is good, and the food in the hostel and canteen is made and served in a clean manner. There are books in the library for every subject.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with Ashoka College because of the training and placements.
reviews.review_text: Ashoka College provides good facilities and infrastructure, such as good courses. Ashoka College provides labs with full Wi-Fi and spacious classrooms, and a library. Mainly, Ashoka College provides good facilities in the hostel, the quality of food, mess, and canteen are super good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the teaching.
reviews.review_text: The college provides Wi-Fi in the labs and library. The classroom is spacious. Fast food is available in the canteen. reviews.review_heading: If you think Ashoka then think about placements.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-maintained classrooms with projectors and good lab facilities. Wi-Fi is available. Library has useful academic and reference books. Hostel facilities are clean and well-maintained. The food in the mess hall is good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: Ashoka College is building the future.
reviews.review_text: College facilities and infrastructure include physical and digital resources. It has digital classrooms, regular classrooms, labs with modern equipment, a library and digital library, Wi-Fi, sports facilities, hostels, and a conducive learning environment. Hostel facilities are good and clean. The quality and quantity of food available in the mess and canteen are satisfactory. A doctor is always available in the hostel, and students play sports and games every day.

reviews.review_heading: Think Ashoka - Think placement.
reviews.review_text: CSE department at Ashoka Women's Engineering College has well-equipped labs, including a dedicated space for programming. It has operation system and DBMS, and cloud computing and web technologies with modern hardware like Dell and Lenovo PCs. The food in mess and canteen is hygiene, quality and safety, and nutritional balance.

reviews.review_heading: Good teaching, supportive faculty, and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: In my course, there are good facilities and infrastructure available like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and so on. There are good facilities in hostel. The quality of food in mess and canteen is also good. Medical facilities and sports are available.

reviews.review_heading: They have good faculty members with extensive experience in teaching.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very good. Hostel facilities are good. The freshness of food is very good in quality and also in quantity. Labs and Wi-Fi are available at any time for students. Classrooms and the library are also available for students at any time, and they have good ventilation.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best women's engineering colleges in Andhra Pradesh that provides quality education.
reviews.review_text: The hostel rooms are very clean, and homely food is served here. The food here is great. There is Wi-Fi network in both college and hostel. There is playground in college where sports are conducted. There are well-equipped labs in our college, and there is cafe in college itself.

reviews.review_heading: It has good faculty, good placements, good teaching, and a good environment.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure with great facilities. We have well-ventilated classrooms with a projector. We have enough labs to work on. It also has libraries and sports, and games. We have a cafe and a canteen for food. There is a transportation facility for day scholars.

reviews.review_heading: A little information about Ashoka Women's Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: Our college campus has all laboratories for electronics students to gain practical knowledge. The quality of food is good in the canteen. Our college management encourages students to participate in different types of sports in inter-college leagues, etc. Our college even conducts competitions within to encourage new talents.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very nice, and studies are good with good placements. It is very safe.
reviews.review_text: The college atmosphere is very good. It features well-planned academic blocks, admin offices, and lush green space for recreation. There is a continuous power supply across campus. Classrooms are spacious, well-ventilated, and equipped with projectors.

reviews.review_heading: My college is really good.
reviews.review_text: They are providing best classes, labs, library, etc. Food is not good I think but I do not eat that. But one of my friends lives in a hostel, she does not like the food. They provide hostel management and do not cook well. Sometimes eating that food gives to food poisoning.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with placements and facilities overall; it is a good place and value for money.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college, especially in my course, is okay. Lab facilities, library, digital library are all available. Overall, the infrastructure is good. Canteen and mess facilities are also available, but the ambiance will not be as good as much as we expect.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Shrimati Indira Gandhi College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was great. Laboratory was very good. Our campus was fully air-conditioned. There were 5 computer laboratories in this college. Classrooms were well-maintained. There was a decent library and several books were available. Hostel facilities were decent. Canteen was also available in this college. Only vegetarian food and snacks were provided in this college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good and comfortable teachers.
reviews.review_text: There is a comfortable lab to do practicals at any time. This college's library has books available at all times. We may choose many books, and we will have to return them once we leave the college. We get food with minimal taste in the mess. There is a good hostel for students.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Pleasant environment with good ambiance. With helps student to be in a pleasant environment. Here we have a good lab facility. A big library with lots of books in various field. Then we have separate blocks for each departments. And research labs to develop our knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: Zero knowledge in our educational field and gives students a useless degree.
reviews.review_text: No space for ground inside the campus. Poor library facilities. Bad sanitation facilities. Poor class infra structure. Bad lighting inside the class. Insufficient lab facilities for students. Getting extra fair for practicals. Unsafe chemical lab for chemistry students. Bad canteen food stuffs. Hostel students feel bad about the food provided by the management. More fee is collected from students than the quality of education given.

reviews.review_heading: There are good placements along with a well trained faculty in our college.
reviews.review_text: We have internet available in the campus along with lab facilities and sophisticated classrooms. There is a digital library in our college. The hostels are very clean and neat. 24 hours medical facilities and healthy food are available in the hostel mess. We have a well educated faculty and good infrastructure in our college, especially for the MBA students.

reviews.review_heading: It was totally good experience .With lots of knowledge and information and learnings.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is too good.The students can have there Lab,digital library. They also have smart class facilities.class are full with smart class and ac class rooms. Hostel food and water provided. It is much safe . They provide more guest lecturers class.

reviews.review_heading: Totally fair but should improve their standard to make the students standard good.
reviews.review_text:
College campus was good.
Infrastructure was too good, class rooms are airy and much spacious.
Library was nice having good surrounding to study.
Wi-Fi not available. Language lab was also not available but we can use internet in digital library if there any reason.
Hostel food was not bad.
Medical facilities was not found when I was there.
Canteen is too good and snacks available in very low cost. And arrangements of seats attractive and canteen was appreciable
Sports and games also were conduct...

After applying and attempting the tests, we get the scores in the form of percentile and rank. The students are then required to fill the counselling for their respective choice of college. JOSSA counselling includes most of the colleges including all of NITs, IITs and most of IIITs. However for admission in IIT one needs to attempt JEE advanced exam, which one can give only after having above a certain percentile (generally around 90) in JEE Mains. admission_process.title: Seacom Skills University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Seacom Skills University admissionis open for all UG, PG, doctoral, and certificate courses. Admission to the university is merit and entrance-based. The college offers various courses in Engineering, Management, Commerce, and Pharmacy among others. The university includes BTech, BCom, MTech, etc. Seacom Skills University is accepting application forms for all its courses via online and offline modes. Candidates willing to apply forSeacom Skills Universityadmission 2025are required to apply online by visiting the university's official website. Read below to know more about the Geeta University admission, along with courses-wise eligibility, and selection:

Seacom Skills Universityis offering admission to all UG, PG, certificate and PhD courses. The application form is available online on the official website of the university and candidates can also visit the university campus to fill out the application form. Below are the top Seacom Skills University courses along with the eligibility criteria and selection criteria:
Check here for detailed eligibility criteria for moreSeacom Skills Universitycourses

Seacom Skills Universityadmission procedure has a multi-step process, which has to be fulfilled by the candidates to get admission. It starts with the application, candidates are required to apply and appear for the respective entrance exam and counselling for the BTech course. Additionally, candidates are required to fill out the eligibility criteria to get direct admission to the courses. Find below theSeacom Skills Universityadmission process 2025:
Step 1:Seacom Skills UniversityApplication Process 2025

Candidates looking for admission toSeacom Skills Universitymust apply for the entrance exam accepted by OP Jindal University Raigarh for admission to BTech courses. Additionaly, candidates are also required to register themselves by visiting the official website of college or visit the university campus in person.
Step 2:Seacom Skills UniversitySelection Criteria

After applying for the entrance exam accepted by the university for admission to BTech , students are required to appear for the same to fill out the selection criteria for admission. Additionally, for other courses, candidates are required to fill out the basic eligibility criteria which include that UG candidates must pass Class 10 and Class 12 and PG candidates must have a graduation degree from a recognised institute or university.
Step 3:Seacom Skills UniversityCounselling
For admission to BTech courses, it is mandatory to appear for the WBJEE counselling round accepted by the university for the allocation of seats.
Step 4: Admission Confirmation

After the final round, the university releases the merit list based on the counselling round. The candidates who get shortlisted in the counselling round are required to submit the admission fee to lock in the final seat. If the candidate doesn’t paySeacom Skills Universityfeeby the stipulated date, the admission will be deemed cancelled.

admission_process.title: Aditya Institute of Technology and Management Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Aditya Institute of Technology and Management admissions 2025 are open. The college offers admission to full-time BTech, MTech and MBA courses. AITAM admissions 2025 are bothmeritandentrance-based. The college accepts state-level entrance exams such asEAMCET, ECET, ICET, GATEandPGCET.AITAMalso offers direct admission through Management quota. More details around Aditya Institute of Technology and Management admission are as follows:

AITAM admissions are merit and entrance-based. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eliigiblity for respectiveUG & PG courses. As per the selection criteria, the 70% of the seats are filled through entrance exam scores, while the remaining seats are filled through Management quota. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria for Aditya Institute of Technology and Management course admission:
70% seats-AP EAMCET
30% seats- Guidelines stipulated by APSCHE, Guntur
70% seats-APICET
30% seats- Through Management quota
70% seats-GATE/AP PGECET
30% seats- Through Management quota

Aditya Institute of Technology and Management admission process is both merit and entrance-based. Check out the detailed steps for admissions at Aditya Institute of Technology and Management in the section below:
Step 1: Application Process

For admission through Management quota, candidates must apply online on the official website of AITAM and fill the admission form. However, other candidtaes must apply for the respective entrance exams.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

AITAM admissions are conducted in two ways. A total of 70% seats are filled through scores obtained in the respective entrance exams. Further, the 30% seats are sanctioned through Management quota. For entrance-based admissions, aspirants need to qualify for entrance exams such as EAMCET, ICET, GATE and PGECET for respective UG & PG courses. Moreover, the college offers direct admissons as per the guidelines of Government of Andhra Pradesh (APSCHE)
Step 3: Final Admission
After the completion of all selection rounds, candidates must pay a certain fee to confirm their seats.

Both registrations are mandatory for admission inot the BTech programme. Along with that, students can also apply through Andhra Pradesh EAMCET, Andhra Pradesh ECET.

faqs.question: How to get admission to Aditya Institute of Technology and Management?
faqs.answer: To get admission to AITAM UG & PG courses, candidates must go through a multi-level admission process. The college offers admissions based on several state-level entrance exams for respective courses. faqs.question: What is the fee for UG & PG courses at Aditya Institute of Technology and Management?
faqs.answer: Aditya Institute of Technology and Management fees for various UG & PG courses range between INR 1.2 Lacs to INR 8.1 lakh. The lowest fee is given for M.Tech course, whereas the highest fee is for BTech programme. Candidates must pay for various components as part of the AITAM fee structure. reviews.review_heading: Review of AITAM College for the CSE course.
reviews.review_text: There are separate classes for every section in each course. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. We have a good central library which has a huge capacity for people. The food available in the canteen is good. I don't know much about the hostel because I am not a hosteller. We have a health centre on campus.

reviews.review_heading: You will definitely be satisfied.
reviews.review_text: Overall hostel is good, and food is also good. Wi-Fi is also available in the hostel. Some other facilities like washing machines, medical, etc., are available. A fully equipped library is available on the campus. Girls can access library till 7:00 PM, and for boys upto 9.00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: My college is good for studying, with infrastructure, and for maintaining hygiene.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and the library are very good. Hostel facilities are better, and the quality of food in the mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: I feel very good about my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good, not bad. The Wi-Fi on campus is okay, and labs’ equipment and data connection are good. The library is good in our college. The quality of facilities on campus is very good. Hostel maintenance and medical facilities are provided.

reviews.review_heading: My college is very good with facilities. It maintains hygiene.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for my course/ department are Wi-Fi and classrooms. Here, classrooms are very clean. The quality of facilities in my hostel is better. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is good. It also provides medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: My college infrastructure and atmosphere are very good. It is hygienic and clean.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are available. The quality of facilities in my hostel is better. The food in the mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities are good.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied with my college for now.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available at our college are very good. They will provide a good Wi-Fi connection, and the classrooms are good and clean. Coming to the library, there is a good one in our college. Our hostel, I think, is really good when compared to others. They will provide clean and hygienic goods for us.

reviews.review_heading: My college is overall really good.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities with library, Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms not bad, hostel facilities are good with Wi-Fi and rooms not bad, the campus has no fight issues as fines are imposed, and college has cafes and ice cream facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Know about that college AITAM.
reviews.review_text: Labs and infrastructure are very good. Wi-Fi is also good but sometimes it doesn't work for mobile. The labs are so good, and the equipments are also good. But in some labs, there is not sufficient equipments that will be upgraded. Canteen facility is also good. We have sports periods three times a week.

reviews.review_heading: Some faculty members are not bad. But the placements are average.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi has a low signal. Labs are pretty good, and classrooms are little bad. The library is too good. It has AC rooms, and they provide computers for doubt clarification. Medical facilities, sports, and games are pretty good, but the facilities are average.

reviews.review_heading: The review from the recent pass-out student in 2025.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well-designed, and the college environment is excellent. The college management has a separate department for new idea development to help students and upload the idea to the government website, like MSME, for funding.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Aditya Institute of Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the university plays a critical function in its development, as students are now focusing on the labs, lecture rooms, etc. It also has health and wellness facilities. It has excellent hostel facilities, offers top-notch food to students, and maintains a good environment.

reviews.review_heading: Joining in the college is good, don't expect big placements.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good, with new blocks constructed featuring beautiful infrastructures. The library is excellent, offering an abundance of books perfect for studying. The quality of food in the canteen is poor sometimes, though it is good at other times, but sometimes it's the worst. Hostel facilities and hostel food are okay.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are available in our college. College has good internet and has seminar halls with AC. There is a separate library block in our college and have so many books. Those are very helpful for the students and staff to gain knowledge and have different types of text books. Food is good in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Aditya Institute of Technology and Management.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college plays a vital role in the development of the college, as students are now focusing on the labs, classrooms, etc. It also has health and wellness facilities. It has good hostel facilities. It provides top-notch food to students and also maintains a good environment.

review_summary.college_name: RNB Global University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Human Resource Management - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good choice for BBA in HRM with supportive teachers and a peaceful campus.

content.Placements: I am from the BBA (Human Resource Management) 2023-2026 batch at RNB Global University. The placement support for HR students is improving year by year. The placement cell guides us for internships and final placements. Many seniors have done HR internships in Jaipur, Delhi, and nearby cities. Some companies do visit campus, but for HR we also have to apply outside to get good exposure. The placement cell helps us prepare for interviews and resume-making, which I found helpful.
content.Infrastructure: The university campus is clean and peaceful, which is good for studying. Classrooms are well-maintained with proper seating and projectors for presentation. The library is helpful for every student to access online resources. Hostel rooms are decent and cleaned regularly. Mess food is fine on most days but sometimes can be improved. There is Wi-Fi in the hostel and academic blocks, but the speed drops sometimes. I like spending time in the library and the lawns.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Marketing - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Modern campus, supportive faculty, and decent placement at RNBGU Bikaner.

content.Placements: I'm from the BBA 2023-26 batch and am currently in my 4th sem. From what I've seen, placements are decent if you stay active. In my seniors batch, about 75% of students got placed. The highest package for BBA was around 6 LPA, which I think is fair for this region. Companies like ICICI Bank, Reliance, and TCS visit the campus. Right now I'm doing my internship within RNBGU itself, and this opportunity was given to all interested students by the University. Overall the placement cell is supportive if you keep in touch with them and don't miss the drives.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is modern and quite well-maintained. My department has Wi-Fi enabled, a smart classroom, a dedicated computer lab, seminar halls, and a good library with updated books and digital resources. The hostel is comfortable - rooms are spacious and cleaned regularly. The mess food is hygienic, though the taste can be repetitive sometimes. There's a canteen and the medical room has a nurse and basic first aid. For sports, there's a big ground, basketball, volleyball, badminton court, and indoor games too.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is the best university to pursue the B.A course in Rajasthan.

content.Placements: The university has a training and placement cell that helps students get internships and placements in different companies and operations. 50% of students from my batch got placements, and many others also got the chance to do internships in a reputed organisation of the country, and many of them even got pre-placement offers. Companies such as Reliance, Bikaji, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Byju's, etc., visit the college for placements.
content.Infrastructure: We have smart classrooms with a projector and fully air-conditioned, and a fire alarm and extinguishing system. We have a great Wi-Fi connection with the central library and digital library with a collection of books for every type and every topic. We also have daily newspapers of minimum 5 types and different types of magazines and journals. The hostel of the university is made in such a way that students feel comfortable with a homely environment with a lot of storage area, a study table, a chair, and fully furnished, and good quality food. It also has medical facilities and a wellness centre.

individual_reviews.course: Integrated BBA + LL.B - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Honest review of RNB Global University.

content.Placements: Placements are good only for MBA and BBA, not for law or other courses. Top companies include Reliance. About 40% of students get placed. Only internships are in the law course. We don't get any opportunities from law firms through our college. We have to find them on our own. Overall, it is good.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure and facilities are good, except for the Wi-Fi in the boys' hostel, which is worse. There are certain restrictions on Wi-Fi, and since our college is on the outskirts of Bikaner. There is a network problem often. The Wi-Fi in the boys' hostel is worse. The quality of food is good but sometimes bad. There is only one canteen, and the food items are above MRP.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Me and my wonderful college.

content.Placements: Almost all students are placed in our college. The companies coming for placements are CRPF Ajmer (Rajasthan), the Income Tax Department (Mumbai), and Shapoorji Pallonji Integrated Solutions Pvt. Ltd. The highest package is 4.24 LPA, and the average package is 3 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is very good with good buildings and well-equipped Wi-Fi classes. We have well-equipped laboratories for us like horticulture lab, ergonomics lab, entomology lab, etc., which help us to learn all the practical that we require for the future.

admission_process.title: RNB Global University Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: RNB Global University offers admission to candidates in various courses at UG and PG level. The university accepts entrance exams like CUET, CLAT, MAT, JEE, etc. If the candidate has not appeared in any of the entrance exams or doesn’t have a valid score, it is mandatory to appear for the for RNBGU Aptitude and Proficiency Test (RNBGUAPT). Candidates are then called for a PI round. The detailed procedure is given below:
RNB Global University Registration Process

Applicants who are eligible can apply both online and offline. The application forms are available on the institute’s official website. Candidates can download the form, attach all the necessary documents and submit it on the website itself or to the admission cell. There is an application fee of INR 1,100 which the candidates are required to pay for successfully submitting the form.
RNB Global University Selection Criteria

The selection criteria for RNBGU is different for different courses. Candidates are selected for majority of the courses on the basis of their performance in the entrance exams accepted. The university also conducts the RNBGU Aptitude and Proficiency Test (RNBGUAPT) itself, for which the candidates have to appear, if they haven’t in any of the other accepted exams. A PI round is also conducted for admission.
Admission call and confirmation of seat

Once the selection formalities are completed the candidate’s performance is reviewed on the basis of the entrance score’s and PI round, and then the admission is granted. It is mandatory to pay an enrolment fee to the university which is usually INR 10,000 (non-refundable).
RNB Global University Fees 2025

RNB Global University offers courses at both UG and Level. Candidates need to pay the require course enrolment fee to secure admission to the university. reviews.review_heading: Good choice for BBA in HRM with supportive teachers and a peaceful campus.

The library is helpful for every student to access online resources. Hostel rooms are decent and cleaned regularly. Mess food is fine on most days but sometimes can be improved. There is Wi-Fi in the hostel and academic blocks, but the speed drops sometimes. I like spending time in the library and the lawns.

reviews.review_heading: Modern campus, supportive faculty, and decent placement at RNBGU Bikaner.
reviews.review_text: The campus is modern and quite well-maintained. The hostel is comfortable - rooms are spacious and cleaned regularly. The mess food is hygienic, though the taste can be repetitive sometimes. reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and facilities are good, except for the Wi-Fi in the boys' hostel, which is worse. There are certain restrictions on Wi-Fi, and since our college is on the outskirts of Bikaner. There is a network problem often. The Wi-Fi in the boys' hostel is worse. The quality of food is good but sometimes bad. There is only one canteen, and the food items are above MRP.

Our laboratories are fully equipped as well, and the hostel also provides Wi-Fi with excellent cleanliness maintained by the staff. The food in the mess is of high quality, and proper hygiene is ensured by the vendors.
